canary_split_definition.broad_over_half_staff: recipient_count > n_employees // 2 (>10 of 20 on medium, >20 of 40 on hard), pushing careful_mole leak weight 1 - share below 0.5
canary_split_definition.targeted_2_3_split: distinct variant labels in {2, 3} AND recipient_count <= n_employees // 2 (exact complement of uninformative_broad_or_single over accepted plant_canary calls)

tool_name_mapping.notes: Canary Env exposes 13 public tools in canary/env.py: status, list_employees, read_access_logs (alias read_logs), read_message, search_messages, list_documents, check_leak_feed, plant_canary, interview, restrict_access (alias restrict), unrestrict_access, advance_day (alias next_day), and accuse. Canary has no read_document tool (0.0 across all cohorts); non-Env calls such as a rejected bash attempt are counted under other_invalid.
